facts.text: The hotel is housed in a building from the 1920s.
facts.excerpt: Housed in an architectural masterpiece from the 1920s, the Kimpton Harper Hotel blends Fort Worth history with modern style.

facts.text: The hotel's lobby is on the 24th floor and has sweeping views and a lively bar scene.
facts.excerpt: In the 24th-floor lobby, sweeping views and a lively bar scene beckon in equal measure.

facts.text: il Modo is the hotel's restaurant serving a contemporary take on Italian culinary traditions.
facts.excerpt: il Modo, our bustling restaurant, puts a contemporary spin on the Italian culinary traditions.

facts.text: Refinery 714 is the hotel's penthouse lounge, serving cocktails.
facts.excerpt: Saddle up for well-crafted cocktails with imaginative flair at Refinery 714, our penthouse lounge.

facts.text: Refinery 714 is named for the hotel's address, 714 Main Street.
facts.excerpt: Refinery 714, our penthouse lounge. Named for our address

facts.text: The seating at Refinery 714 looks over the Texas plains and downtown Fort Worth.
facts.excerpt: luxe seating affords sweeping views of the Texas plains and downtown Fort Worth.

facts.text: Pets stay free and no pet deposit is required.
facts.excerpt: Pets always stay free and no pet deposit is required.

facts.text: The hotel does not have a pool.
facts.excerpt: No, Kimpton Harper Hotel does not have a pool.

facts.text: Overnight self parking costs 45 US dollars.

facts.excerpt: Yes, the Kimpton Harper Hotel offers free WiFi!

facts.text: The hotel has a fitness center.
The hotel's suites range from studios to presidential-style suites.
facts.excerpt: Stretch out in our spacious suites, which range from sumptuous studios to sprawling presidential- style digs.

facts.text: The hotel has no complimentary local area shuttle.
facts.excerpt: No, there is not a complimentary local area shuttle available at Kimpton Harper Hotel.
